description: Assert that the discovered fields match an expected field specification. Returns a structured diff: missing fields, type mismatches, enum value mismatches, and extra fields. all_match=true only when there are no missing fields and no type or enum mismatches. Extra discovered fields do not affect all_match. Run after aethis_discover_fields to verify field coverage before writing test cases. If all_match=false, call aethis_refine_fields with guidance about the missing or incorrect fields.

expected_fields.description: The fields you expect to find in the discovered field set

enum_values.description: For Enum fields: the expected allowed values. Omit to skip enum value check.

sort.description: Expected field type: Bool, Int, Enum, Date, Duration, String

name: aethis_validate_fields
